plain: Lack of respect for God or sacred things.

webster.text: Ungodliness; irreverence towards the Supreme Being; contempt of the divine character and authority; neglect of the divine precepts.

example.quote: Slavery has been the foundation of that impiety and dissipation which have been so much disseminated among our countrymen.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 25, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
